card.name: Numbered requirements and units in educational text
card.fires_on: Spots just before a number or step in scouting requirements, tutorial unit references, and scale ratios. Examples are the space before 'Requirement 2', the colon in '1:300', and 'Unit' before a number.

modes.label: Merit badge task lists
modes.description: Words in merit badge instructions, such as the colon after 'following' or 'badge' before counselor.
